name: acorn
_note: Pinned per #1710 project-lead decision (2026-05-29): acquire acorn via a pinned npm-pack tarball, NOT a vendored source copy. The tarball is committed as a fixture so the harness reproduces from a clean checkout with NO run-time network. shasum is the canonical npm sha1 (`npm view acorn@8.16.0 dist.shasum`); integrity is the canonical npm sha512 (`dist.integrity`). To refresh: `npm pack acorn@<ver>`, update this file, re-run setup. The SAME tarball is the compiled-acorn source AND the node-acorn differential oracle, so any AST divergence is a compiler bug, never version skew.
